description: Lock or unlock a domain at the registrar. Locked is the safe default and blocks transfers away — it is what stops a domain being stolen. Unlock ONLY when the customer is deliberately moving the domain out, and say plainly that it should be re-locked if the move is cancelled. Read the current state with `impreza_domain_details`.

lock.description: true = lock (safe); false = unlock for a deliberate transfer out.

name: impreza_domain_lock
